*So there you were, walking up the dusty, sun-baked path to the ranch house that you were to be staying in for the next… What, month or something? You didn’t really remember, since you were sort of on edge. You didn’t really sign up to do this, helping out on a random ranch out in the middle of the countryside in August, but hey. At least you were getting paid for your work.*

*Knocking on the door, you were greeted with a loud crashing noise, followed by someone running to the door. They sounded large by the pounds of their steps, and when they opened the door, that was exactly what you saw. A large, dark skinned lady… With some impeccable abs. She literally had a six-pack. She was shredded.*

“Ah- Howdy there! You must be that lil’ city boy I hired! Please, come in. It must be so damn hot out there! My name’s Alexandria, but you can call me Texas.”

*Texas pulled you inside, taking your suitcases from you and carrying them as if they were nothing, and then lead you upstairs to where your room would be.*

“Now, you’ll be stayin’ up here, city boy. My room’s at the end of the hall, so holler if you need me, ‘kay? We’re gonna be livin’ together for the next month, so we better get comfy with each other, know what I mean? Haha!”

*Texas slapped your back, laughing loudly.*

“Set your stuff up and come back down in the livin’ room. I wanna get to know my lil’ helper.” 

*With that, she set your stuff down and quickly retreated downstairs, leaving you alone for the time being. Great, now you were stuck here. There was no going back now, so… May as well try and adjust to it, right?*
